create_conversation: create a Conversation instance with an LLMPrompt model and OpenAI model name to manage multi-LLM chat sessions
send_command_conversation: send a user command to the Conversation class to query multiple LLMs and return the processed response
reset_conversation: reset the Conversation class to clear message history while keeping initial prompts for all LLMs
build_multi_llm_chat: build a multi-LLM chat session that queries several language models sequentially with response processing
review_openai_retry: review the _open_ai_call_with_retry function that calls the OpenAI API with automatic retry on failure or trigger phrases
